messages.content: Tell me some of the major airports in the United States.

message.content:
Here are some of the major airports in the United States, ranked by passenger traffic and importance as international hubs:

| Airport | City | State | IATA Code | Notable Features |
|---------|------|-------|-----------|------------------|
| Hartsfield‑Jackson Atlanta International Airport | Atlanta | Georgia | ATL | Largest airport in the world by passenger traffic; major hub for Delta Air Lines. |
| Los Angeles International Airport | Los Angeles | California | LAX | Major gateway to Asia and Latin America; busiest airport on the West Coast. |
| Chicago O’Hare International Airport | Chicago | Illinois | ORD | One of the busiest airports in the world; major hub for United Airlines and American Airlines. |
| Dallas/Fort Worth International Airport | Dallas/Fort Worth | Texas | DFW | Largest airport in the U.S. by land area; major hub for American Airlines. |
| Denver International Airport | Denver | Colorado | DEN | Largest airport in the U.S. by land area; major hub for United Airlines and Southwest Airlines. |
| John F. Kennedy International Airport | New York City | New York | JFK | Major gateway to Europe and the Caribbean; hub for many international carriers. |
| San Francisco International Airport | San Francisco | California | SFO | Major hub for United Airlines; key gateway to Asia and the Pacific Rim. |
| Seattle–Tacoma International Airport | Seattle | Washington | SEA | Major hub for Alaska Airlines and Delta Air Lines; gateway to the Pacific Northwest. |
| Miami International Airport | Miami | Florida | MIA | Major hub for American Airlines; key gateway to Latin America and the Caribbean. |
| Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport | Phoenix | Arizona | PHX | Major hub for American Airlines; one of the busiest airports in the Southwest. |
| Newark Liberty International Airport | Newark | New Jersey | EWR | Major hub for United Airlines; gateway to the Northeast. |
| Charlotte Douglas International Airport | Charlotte | North Carolina | CLT | Major hub for American Airlines; one of the fastest-growing airports in the U.S. |
| Orlando International Airport | Orlando | Florida | MCO | Major hub for Southwest Airlines; key gateway to theme parks and tourism. |
| Detroit Metropolitan Wayne County Airport | Detroit | Michigan | DTW | Major hub for Delta Air Lines; one of the largest airports in the Midwest. |

These airports serve as major hubs for domestic and international flights, handling millions of passengers each year and connecting travelers to destinations around the globe.
